jobs.title: SAP Signavio Implementation & Governance Consultant (Project Architect)
jobs.description:
Overview:
**Location:** Fully Remote (U.S.\-Based) quarterly travel (up to 4 times per year) to Denver, CO or Minneapolis, MN  

**Employment Type:** Full\-Time Contract (Long\-Term Engagement) **Lead Enterprise Process Governance Transformation**
Are you a seasoned SAP Signavio expert who has successfully built governance programs from the ground up? Trissential is hiring an experienced **SAP Signavio Implementation \& Governance Consultant** to join our client's team and play a critical role in a major Customer Core transformation initiative.  

This is not a traditional process modeling position. You'll have the opportunity to architect and implement enterprise\-wide governance standards, establish sustainable operating models, and help shape how business processes are governed, measured, and improved across a large organization.  

If you enjoy influencing stakeholders, creating structure from ambiguity, and driving strategic process transformation through SAP Signavio, this is a career\-defining opportunity. **What's In It for You?*** Lead a highly visible enterprise transformation initiative with executive exposure
* Own the development of governance frameworks from strategy through implementation
* Shape the future state of process governance across a large organization
* Work remotely while collaborating with senior leaders and business stakeholders
* Join a multi\-year program expected to run for at least three years
* Exercise significant autonomy as a trusted subject matter expert
* Drive measurable improvements through governance, process intelligence, and analytics
* Influence enterprise process maturity and organizational adoption at scale

**Your Role \& Responsibilities*** Lead the implementation and scaling of SAP Signavio governance capabilities across the Customer Core Program
* Partner with the Process Governance Manager to define governance strategy, ownership structures, and operational standards
* Design and implement governance frameworks including process ownership, approval workflows, repository management, and version control standards
* Configure and administer SAP Signavio modules including Process Manager, Collaboration Hub, Governance, Process Intelligence, and Process Insights
* Establish repository structures, access controls, permissions, security models, and governance workflows
* Define, develop, and implement governance dashboards, reporting capabilities, KPIs, and process health metrics
* Drive enterprise adoption through stakeholder engagement, communications, training, onboarding, and change management activities
* Collaborate with SAP, architecture, business, and data teams to enable integrations and process intelligence capabilities
* Create enterprise standards, governance operating models, implementation roadmaps, and best practices
* Identify governance risks, process gaps, compliance concerns, and continuous improvement opportunities
* Present governance maturity, adoption metrics, recommendations, and business outcomes to senior leadership
* Serve as the organization's SAP Signavio governance subject matter expert

**Skills \& Experience You Should Possess*** 7\+ years of business process transformation, business process management, SAP, process excellence, or governance experience
* 4\+ years of hands\-on SAP Signavio implementation and administration experience
* Proven experience standing up and scaling SAP Signavio for large enterprise organizations
* Deep expertise in SAP Signavio Governance functionality
* Experience developing and implementing enterprise governance frameworks
* Hands\-on experience configuring governance structures rather than solely performing process modeling activities
* Experience designing process ownership, approval workflows, repository structures, and version control standards
* Strong knowledge of Signavio Process Intelligence, Process Insights, and Process Mining capabilities
* Experience influencing stakeholders across multiple business groups without direct authority
* Demonstrated ability to work independently in ambiguous environments with minimal ramp\-up
* Strong communication, facilitation, training, and presentation skills
* Experience delivering executive\-level reporting, governance metrics, and strategic recommendations

**Bonus Points If You Have*** Utility, energy, or regulated industry experience
* Experience building governance programs from the ground up
* SAP ecosystem expertise and enterprise SAP integrations
* Jira experience
* Confluence experience
* Experience supporting large\-scale enterprise transformation initiatives
* Process excellence, BPM, Lean, or continuous improvement background
* Experience developing governance adoption and change management programs

**Education \& Certifications You Need*** Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Business, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline preferred
* SAP Signavio Certification strongly preferred
* Relevant SAP certifications are considered a plus
* Business Process Management, Process Excellence, or Governance certifications are beneficial

**What We Offer**
At Trissential, we believe exceptional professionals deserve exceptional opportunities. By joining our client's team, you'll work on a highly strategic transformation initiative while enjoying the flexibility, autonomy, and support needed to make a meaningful impact* **Competitive Compensation** – **$111\-$121 per hour**. Final compensation is determined based on skill alignment, years of experience, and fair, market\-based rates by geography.
* Comprehensive Benefits for you and your dependents – Extensive Medical Plans, Dental, Vision, HSA with company contribution, company sponsored Life Insurance and Short / Long term disability insurance, a host of voluntary plans including legal, hospital, accident, pet wellness, and 401k with matching
* Paid Holidays and Paid Time Off
* Career Development and Advancement – Expleo is a global company in 29 Countries worldwide with a high focus on development
* Strong Team Culture – Collaborate with experienced professionals who value precision, performance, and teamwork

**Work Authorization**
This opportunity is available only to candidates who are currently authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship restrictions **Ready to Be Part of Something Exciting?**
If you've successfully led SAP Signavio governance implementations and are looking for an opportunity to make a lasting impact on a large\-scale transformation program, we'd love to speak with you. Apply today and help shape the future of process governance with Trissential

jobs.title: Lead Implementation Consultant - Healthcare
jobs.description:
Overview:

The Lead Implementation Consultant is a post\-sales position that focuses on individual clients and implementing Cotiviti solutions purchased by that client. The Implementation Consultant will generally be involved in installing, configuring, and overseeing the implementation of Cotiviti products with the client. This includes installation of products on Cotiviti or client hardware; configuration and development of programs, tasks and guidelines, to fully implement a Cotiviti solution based upon a client’s specific needs. The Implementation Consultant will be the primary Client Services technical resource and will interface with the client’s technical resources. Duties can range from delivery of product training to new client specific requirements, development and deployment. The role involves client coordination and communication as well as a high technical understanding of Cotiviti solutions as well as the transactions that flow through this position.
Responsibilities:
* Coordinate and communicate with the client post\-sale to develop an implementation plan for implementing and configuring a purchased Cotiviti solution based upon a client’s individual needs.
* Collaborate with the Cotiviti Implementation Architect / Technical Project Manager to formulate the architecture, implementation strategy/schedule and operational plan.
* Install, upgrade and configure Cotiviti products for the client.
* Integrate Cotiviti products with other software assets/processes for the customer.
* Coordinate with other Client Services, Product and Development team members to meet development and configuration milestones, being able to develop guidelines, programs, tasks, reports, etc. to meet the client’s requirements.
* Provide post\- implementation support during the transition from implementation to maintenance.
* Provide software and client specific training and develop training documentation based on present standards and client needs.
* Mentor and train internal teams upon Cotiviti products and customer custom components.
* Work with customers as a SME upon purchased Cotiviti products and solutions.
* Strong written and verbal presentation skills required. Must be comfortable interacting with client’s technical teams.
* Must be able to manage or participate in the testing and release cycle tasks for deployment of Cotiviti products and services for the client.
* Must be able to create detailed user and operational documentation to support the deployment of products and services to the client.
* Must be comfortable delivering technical training to the customer as part of the customer's software release and deployment cycle.
* Excellent communications, presentation and interpersonal skills.
* Complete all responsibilities as outlined in the annual performance review and/or goal setting.
* Complete all special projects and other duties as assigned.
* Must be able to perform duties with or without reasonable accommodation.


This job description is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed and is not to be construed as an exhaustive list of responsibilities, duties and skills required. This job description does not constitute an employment agreement and is subject to change as the needs of Cotiviti and requirements of the job change.
Qualifications:
* Over 5 years of understanding of Application Integration/ Enterprise Application Integration.
* 8\-10 years of working experience on middleware tools \- JCAPS, Web method, WMBI, AquaLogic etc. OR have worked on or have an understanding of other messaging engines \- IBM MQ, Active MQ etc.
* 8\-10 years of exposure to Integration Design Patterns.
* Over 5 years of good understanding of any of the different message formats like XML, STX, EDI, EDIFACT, ISO, ACORD, HL7, IHE etc.
* 8\-10 years of good working knowledge and experience with Java programming, Java Script, XML, JSON, HTML and some scripting knowledge including Perl scripts.
* Over 5 years of familiarity with Oracle and/or SQL Server as database from an application perspective connection string, SQL scripts, JDBC, and general trouble shooting.
* Over 5 years of experience in DevOps and an understanding of DevSecOps.
* Over 4 years of working knowledge and experience in Kafka, Kubernettes, AWS, AVRO, SQS, S3\.
* Good understanding of Application Server.
* Over 5 years of experience with \- Technical requirements document, process flow diagrams, and deployment and user operations guides.
* Over 5 years of experience in developing technical Design.
* Over 5 years of Release management experience.
* Good Understanding of healthcare (Payer/Provider).
* Understanding of EDI transactions (preferably HIPAA).
* Good process orientation and understanding of product implementation space.
* Good Communication Skills.
* Trouble shooting and Analytical skills.
* Project scope, estimation and change management.
* Knowledge of Implementation methodology of any product or solution.
* Experience in technical training (internal/ external).
* Domestic travel required up to 20%\-25%

**Cognitive/Mental Requirements*** Communicating with others to exchange information.
* Problem\-solving and thinking critically.
* Completing tasks independently.
* Interpreting data.
* Making timely decisions in the context of a workflow.
* Maintaining focus.
* Assessing the accuracy, neatness and thoroughness of the work assigned.
* Learning new tasks and completing tasks in situations that have a speed or productivity quota.
* Remembering and adhering to processes and protocols.
* Applying established protocols in a timely manner

**Physical Requirements and Working Conditions*** Remaining in a stationary position, often standing or sitting for prolonged periods.
* Repeating motions that may include the wrists, hands, and/or fingers.
* Must be able to provide a dedicated, secure work area.
* Must be able to provide high\-speed internet access/connectivity and office setup and maintenance.


Base compensation ranges from $115,000 to $155,000 per year. Specific offers are determined by various factors, such as experience, education, skills, certifications, and other business needs.

jobs.title: Clinical Implementation Specialist
jobs.description:
**Clinical Implementation Specialist**

Account Engagement – I/O Urology Diagnostics Inc (CarePath)

**About I/O Urology**

I/O Urology is dedicated to enhancing the lives of those living with urologic conditions by providing a convenient, accessible, and stress\-free way to monitor their health from the comfort of home. Through our CarePath device, patients gather accurate, reliable data without frequent clinic visits, giving patients and providers immediate access to insights that enhance diagnosis, treatment, and ongoing care.

**Position Summary**

The Clinical Implementation Specialist is the hands\-on partner for clinics adopting the CarePath System. This role ensures that CarePath becomes fully embedded in the clinic’s Lower Urinary Tract Symptom (LUTS) care pathway — that ordering a CarePath Evaluation becomes a routine, reliable step in how the practice works up and manages LUTS patients, and that the resulting reports are consistently retrieved, reviewed, and acted on.

You will work closely with physicians, Advanced Practice Providers (APPs), and clinic operations teams to design, implement, and optimize CarePath workflows — from ordering and receiving CarePath Evaluations to provider review and action planning. This role bridges the clinical and operational sides of healthcare delivery, helping practices efficiently adopt CarePath, improve patient engagement, and deliver better care outcomes through better use of data. Internally, you will collaborate with I/O Urology’s IT, Patient Support, Sales, and Marketing teams to create clarity in the delivery of information through the CarePath Evaluation.

New account onboarding is the center of gravity for this role. Once Sales has established the value of CarePath with the initial ordering providers at an account, you own the transition from interest to routine use CarePath is designed to be simple to implement ; success in this role comes from knowing how a urology clinic operates and being the person every clinic stakeholder—is comfortable working with.

**Key Responsibilities**

**New Account Onboarding**

* Own the handoff from Sales at newly signed accounts and drive the account from initial provider interest to routine, self\-sufficient use of CarePath.
* Onboard the account Administrator to establish and configure I/O Urology portal access
* Train ordering staff to place complete CarePath orders and to retrieve and route CarePath Evaluation reports from the portal.
* Work with the practice and its IT resources to build CarePath into the way orders are already placed in the EMR, including order sets, so that ordering CarePath requires no new habit. Understand how the clinic utilizes its systems to share workflow information between providers and staff.
* Confirm that each new account can independently complete the full cycle — order placed, patient supported, report retrieved, report reviewed — before considering onboarding complete.
* Establish a named point of contact at the account and a clear escalation path back into I/O Urology.

**Clinical Adoption \& Workflow Integration**

* Partner with clinics to integrate CarePath seamlessly into their LUTS care pathways.
* Ensure smooth execution of CarePath processes: ordering, receiving, reviewing, and applying evaluation report insights.
* Coordinate with clinic scheduling staff so that patient appointments align with CarePath evaluation timelines and reports are available when the patient is next seen.
* Train staff on what constitutes a complete and valid order from the treating provider, so that evaluations can be performed without avoidable rework or delay.
* Identify and resolve friction in the CarePath workflow — incomplete orders, reports not reaching the ordering provider, portal access gaps — and re\-train as needed.
* Understand the key players within a clinic’s team – those who often drive activity beyond their title – and leverage their help for CarePath integration into the LUTS care pathways.

**Provider Engagement \& Report Education**

* Be comfortable and credible in front of providers: able to walk a physician or APP through a CarePath Evaluation report and the insights the data reveals about their patient.
* Educate providers on interpreting CarePath data and translating it into their own clinical decision\-making. This education is one of the primary drivers of provider confidence in CarePath and of sustained use
* Bring recurring provider questions, points of confusion, and report\-interpretation themes back to the CMO, Marketing, and Product Development so materials, reports, and product can be improved.
* Coordinate closely with Sales, who own the commercial relationship and the case for CarePath. Your role is to make CarePath easy to use and easy to understand — not to sell it.

**Stakeholder Engagement**

* Build trust\-based relationships across the clinic
* Serve as the day\-to\-day point of contact for CarePath implementation questions at assigned accounts.
* Communicate clearly and adapt to the audience — the same workflow explanation lands differently with a physician, an office manager, and an IT administrator.

**Training \& Ongoing Support**

* Deliver training virtually, using portal walkthroughs and short, role\-specific sessions that fit into a clinic’s day.
* Maintain and improve role\-based training materials and quick\-reference guides for Administrators, ordering staff, and providers.
* Re\-train accounts after staff turnover, as requested, and proactively check in with accounts whose usage patterns suggest a workflow or access problem.
* Support onsite when an account genuinely requires it.

**Internal Collaboration**

* Partner with I/O Urology’s IT team on portal access, integration, and troubleshooting.
* Coordinate as necessary with Patient Support Services to ensure congruity between account and patient engagement.
* Provide Sales with a clear picture of implementation status and readiness at each account.
* Work with Marketing to create adoption tools, communication resources, and educational materials.

**Implementation Quality \& Continuous Improvement**

* Track the operational health of assigned accounts — order completeness, portal proficiency, report retrieval, and time from order to report review — and act on what the data shows.
* Identify and remove barriers within the CarePath workflow itself; escalate recurring or systemic issues internally rather than working around them account by account.
* Contribute to standardizing the implementation playbook so that onboarding is consistent and repeatable across accounts and specialists.
* Document implementation activity and account status accurately and in accordance with I/O Urology policy.

**Qualifications**

**Education \& Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in nursing, healthcare administration, or a related field preferred; equivalent clinical or clinic\-operations experience considered.
* 3–5\+ years of experience in clinic workflow, clinical implementation, care coordination, practice operations, or
* Strongly preferred: direct experience in a urology clinic, or in another specialty clinic with comparable diagnostic ordering workflows. Experience with multiple EMRs
* Working knowledge of how orders are placed in an EMR, including order sets, and of who does what in a clinic between order and result.
* Comfort demonstrating and teaching a web\-based portal to non\-technical users.
* Experience interacting directly with physicians and APPs in a clinical or implementation capacity.
* Familiarity with HIPAA requirements and handling of protected health information.

**Skills \& Competencies**

* **Clinic Workflow Fluency –** Skilled at navigating the real workflow of a busy clinic and identifying where a new step will and will not stick.
* **Interpersonal Range –** Builds rapport quickly and credibly across the full range of clinic stakeholders, from physician to medical assistant to IT.
* **Provider Credibility –** Confident and comfortable speaking with physicians and APPs about clinical data; able to share insight from a CarePath Evaluation without overstepping into clinical decision\-making.
* **Teaching Clarity –** Able to explain a workflow or portal function clearly to someone with limited available time and little interest in software.
* **Organization \& Follow\-Through –** Runs multiple account onboardings in parallel and follows each through to genuine self\-sufficiency.
* **Problem Solving –** Resourceful in diagnosing why a workflow isn’t working — access, training, timing, or ownership — and fixing the actual cause.
* **Remote Effectiveness –** Effective virtually: builds trust and delivers training over video and phone
* **Compliance Judgment –** Understands the boundary between supporting the correct use of a diagnostic service and supporting a practice’s business — and stays on the right side of it.

**Scope \& Compliance Boundaries**

I/O Urology Diagnostics is an Independent Diagnostic Testing Facility (IDTF). The Clinical Implementation Specialist supports the correct ordering, performance, and delivery of the CarePath Evaluation — and nothing beyond it. Specifically, this role:

* Supports workflow only as it relates to CarePath ordering, patient participation, and report retrieval and review; it does not provide general practice management, staffing, throughput, coding, billing, revenue, or marketing consulting to accounts.
* Does not solicit, initiate, modify, or influence the content of a treating provider’s order, and does not order tests on a provider’s behalf.
* Educates providers on the clinical content of CarePath Evaluation reports; it does not make or direct clinical decisions, and does not document in the practice’s medical record or perform the practice’s clinical or administrative work.
* Does not directly solicit patients, and does not offer anything of independent value to an account or its staff as an inducement to order.

All activity is conducted in accordance with I/O Urology’s compliance program, the federal Anti\-Kickback Statute, and applicable IDTF performance standards.

**Work Environment**

This is a predominantly virtual role. CarePath is designed to be straightforward to implement and explain, and most accounts can be fully onboarded and supported remotely. Expect up to 20% travel for accounts where onsite presence is genuinely warranted, along with occasional flexibility outside standard business hours to reach clinic staff and providers when their schedules allow.

**Performance Metrics**

* Time from account signature to first CarePath order placed, and to a fully onboarded account
* Onboarding completeness — Administrator trained, portal access configured, ordering staff trained, report retrieval verified
* Order completeness and accuracy at assigned accounts (rate of orders requiring rework)
* Time from report availability to provider review
* Account self\-sufficiency — reduction in basic access and how\-to support requests after onboarding
* Provider and staff feedback on training quality and responsiveness
* Quality and timeliness of implementation documentation and internal handoffs

**Why Join I/O Urology?**

* Be part of a company redefining the standard of urologic care.
* Help clinics harness the power of better data for better patient outcomes.
* Collaborate with a mission\-driven, passionate team.

**Compensation \& Benefits**

* Competitive salary. Paid time off.
* Comprehensive health, dental, and vision coverage.
* 401(k) with company match.
* Opportunities for professional growth and development.

Pay: $74,000\.00 \- $104,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Flexible schedule
* Flexible spending account
* Health insurance
* Health savings account
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Retirement plan
* Vision insurance

Work Location: Remote

At Virginia Garcia Memorial Health Center, we honor all members of our community and acknowledge the dignity of each person we serve. Our purpose is to provide high quality, comprehensive primary health care to the communities of Washington and Yamhill counties with a special emphasis on migrant and seasonal farm workers and a view to removing barriers to health care. We strive to provide an environment that welcomes and values the people we employ and serve.


If you are unsure whether you meet all the required qualifications for this role but are interested and passionate about this potential position, we encourage you to apply.


Job Summary: The Senior EHR Support Analyst plans, analyzes, modifies, and optimizes Epic EHR as it relates to EpicCare, Wisdom, and Willow applications. The Senior EHR Support Analyst serves as the initial point of contact to support the EHR Support Analysts. In addition to the responsibilities listed below, this position is responsible for mentoring and providing technical support for more junior support team members and training newly hired EHR Support Analysts. This role assists with the evaluation and implementation of work transitioning to the Service Desk.
  

  

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:


* Delivers prompt end\-user customer support to VGMHC employees.
* Provides first and second level support to resolve problems with products and applications.
* Resolves complex problems and provides support to other EHR Support Analysts.
* Spearheads and executes process improvement projects to optimize operational efficiency.
* Fosters key stakeholder relationships, both internally and externally.
* Collaborates with other project managers, maintaining open lines of communication to ensure project success and stakeholder satisfaction.
* Conducts testing of new software implementations, upgrades, and fixes.
* Assumes ownership and accountability for the submission, monitoring, and tracking of Epic items using the JIRA reporting system and an internal Help Desk and Reporting system.
* Assists with efforts to analyze and prioritize incoming Solar Winds (Samanage) requests and alerts and help distribute as needed.
* Provides on\-site elbow support during the implementation of new software applications and system upgrades at each VG site, focusing on the Epic system.
* Collaborates closely with VG's training team to design and implement comprehensive training programs that enable users to leverage new functionality and upgrade rollouts effectively.
* Undertakes project management responsibilities for medium to large projects or sub\-projects.
* Develops comprehensive workflow maps (Visio) and training documentation that accurately captures and articulates changes.
* Conducts feasibility studies on office automation, including workflow analysis, space design considerations, and cost analysis to support informed decision\-making and improve operational efficiencies.
* Cultivates a collaborative and proactive approach with clinic leadership and users to identify opportunities for operational efficiencies, clinical practice support, and improved health outcomes.
* Employs advanced problem\-solving skills and industry knowledge to improve clinic operations and enhance patient care delivery.
* Escalates complex issues through appropriate leadership levels while ensuring effective communication with stakeholders.
* Monitors and tracks resolution of system error pools, such as refill, E\-prescribing, results, and order transmittal errors.
* Updates and maintains member\-managed system setups, including the provider master file, letter templates, Smart Phrases, and other service area files.
* Collaborates with staff to support service area preference lists and Smart Tools to troubleshoot and address user needs.
* Maintains partnership with OCHIN and advisory workgroups support effective implementation of new features and upgrades and to ensure successful adoption and utilization of enhanced functionalities.
* Participates in monthly OCHIN meetings to share best practices and updates.
* Represents EHR in workgroups, including Integration, Claims/Billing, Reporting, Clinical, and Operations.
* Conducts thorough evaluations of software solutions and recommends improvements or upgrades and reports findings to EHR Support Supervisor.
* Takes ownership of creating and maintaining Provider Epic user accounts, Provider Master Files (PMFs), Remote Access, LabCorp Link, Haiku/Canto, and Nuance Dragon Speak.
* Collaborates with VG Communications team to develop, schedule, and deploy CareMessage patient text message outreach.
* Assumes responsibility for creating and maintaining CareMessage user accounts.
* Works with OCHIN and VG Communications team to maintain and update VG MyChart website and application.
* Maintain updated Order Transmittal destination maps as needed.
* Reviews OCHIN alerts or notifications and service/enhancement packs and disseminates information to end users promptly.
* Maintains current knowledge of advancements and best practices in EHR systems, healthcare technology, and regulatory requirements. Participate in conferences, webinars, and advanced training sessions to continuously enhance knowledge and skills related to EHR support, showcasing a relentless pursuit of professional growth and excellence.
* Trains newly hired EHR Support Analysts.
* Follows procedures for incident escalation and notification to EHR Support Supervisor
* Performs other duties and projects as assigned.
* Handle protected health information (PHI) in a manner consistent with the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act of 1996 (HIPAA).

  

HIPAA Requirements:
  

The EHR Support Analyst will have access to PHI in the course of his/her duties. Applying the minimum necessary standard of HIPAA, the designated record sets to which this employee will have access include: all sections of the medical record, patient demographic information in the practice management system, and incoming records, reports, results, consultations, etc. The EHR Site Specialist is required to read the content of these records only to the extent needed to accomplish the assigned task.
  

  

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities required:
  

* Ability to troubleshoot and problem\-solve in a clinical or EHR setting.
* Knowledge of training and teaching strategies, methodologies, and basic instructional concepts.
* Ability to perform effective one\-on\-one and group training.
* Extensive knowledge of EPIC system (EHR and EDR).
* Knowledge of basic medical terminology preferred.
* Proficiency with MS Office Suite (Excel, Word, Outlook, PowerPoint) and ability to demonstrate these skills.
* Excellent Customer Service skills.
* Planning and organizational skills.
* Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, written and verbal.
* Ability to make independent decisions based on VGMHC policies and protocols.
* Bilingual English/Spanish language skills (speaking, reading, and writing) preferred.
* Ability to work effectively in a team environment.
* High degree of confidentiality, integrity, and professionalism.
* Commitment and alignment to Virginia Garcia’s mission, vision, and values.
* Valid Oregon driver’s license, reliable transportation, safe driving record, and insurance coverage required.

  

Education and Experience:
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related field required.
* Minimum three years’ EHR/IT Experience in a support or operations environment.
* OCHIN certification/proficiency required.
* EpicCare Ambulatory Certification required at or within twenty\-four months of hire.
* Epic Prelude Certification required at or within twenty\-four months of hire.
* Epic Cadence Certification required at or within twenty\-four months of hire.
* Experience with vendor management or vendor collaboration preferred.

  

Behavioral Competencies:
  

Accountability: Role model VG’s mission, vision, and shared values
  

Customer\-Focus: Listen to the voice of the customer and strive to delight them by exceeding their expectations
  

Teamwork: If someone needs help, help them
  

Initiative: Be innovative, apply fresh ideas, and continuously improve how you do your work
  

Confidentiality: Maintain strict confidentiality and respect the privacy of others
  

Ethical: Demonstrate integrity, honesty, and stewardship in all encounters at work
  

Respect: Demonstrate consideration and appreciation for co\-workers and patients
  

Communication: Demonstrate the ability to convey thoughts and ideas as well as understand perspective of others
  

  

Physical Requirements:
   

Percentage of time spent
  

* Computer use: up to 90%
* Standing/Walking: up to 30%
* Sitting: up to 90%
* Lifting/Carrying: less than 5%; may occasionally lift up to 20 lbs.
* Travel to multiple locations within Washington and Yamhill counties and working flexible hours.

  

Working Environment:
  

* Work in well\-lighted and ventilated environments.
* Potential exposure to blood borne pathogens and hazardous chemicals.

Office equipment Used:
  

* Computer
* Telephone, fax, copier, scanner, printer

  

Immunization:
  

Staff members must meet immunization requirements as stated in VGMHC’s immunization policy and state and federal guidelines.
Job descriptions represent a general outline of the essential and major job duties, functions and qualifications required. They cannot be all\-inclusive and comprehensive due to the dynamic nature of work performed to accomplish VGMHC’s Mission.


VGMHC is an Equal Opportunity Employer. No person is unlawfully excluded from consideration for employment because of race, color, religious creed, national origin, ancestry, sex, age, veteran status, marital status, or physical challenges. The policy applies not only to recruitment and hiring practices, but also includes fairness in placement, promotion, transfer, rate of pay, and termination.

jobs.title: ServiceNow Implementation Specialist
jobs.description:
Job Description:

NetImpact Strategies is seeking a ServiceNow Implementation Specialist to configure and implement approved ServiceNow capabilities for a Federal Agency. This role translates validated requirements and architecture into maintainable platform configuration, automation, integrations, catalog/workflow capabilities, and controlled production deployments while providing late\-window engineering depth. **Work schedule:** Monday\-Friday, representative late implementation shift supporting the end of the 1:30 p.m.\-10:00 p.m. Eastern service window; planned after\-hours activities and rotating on\-call support as required.

  

This position requires U.S. citizenship and a post\-award Government background investigation.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Configure and implement approved ServiceNow capabilities from validated requirements and CTA\-approved designs, favoring out\-of\-the\-box features and reusable components over avoidable customization.
* Configure forms, tables, Business Rules, Client Scripts, UI Policies, ACLs, Script Includes, Flow Designer flows/subflows/actions, catalog items, notifications, and approved portal/workspace components.
* Implement capabilities across TO\-relevant ServiceNow areas such as ITSM, ITOM/Discovery, CMDB/CSDM, IntegrationHub, SPM, Performance Analytics, App Engine, and other approved products as assigned.
* Build and configure integrations using REST/SOAP APIs, IntegrationHub spokes/actions, MID Servers, service accounts, and approved authentication/certificate patterns; coordinate end\-to\-end testing and operational handoff.
* Support CMDB/configuration\-data implementation and data\-quality validation, including reconciliation with connected systems and approved governance standards.
* Prepare and execute controlled promotions to TEST and PROD using approved update\-set/application\-repository and CI/CD practices; maintain deployment plans, rollback steps, release notes, and configuration evidence.
* Execute unit/functional checks and partner with the Tester on ATF, integration, regression, performance, and UAT validation before release.
* Provide late\-window deployment and implementation support, including troubleshooting, post\-production validation, and handoff to the operations team.
* Support technical\-debt reduction and approved restoration of customized capabilities toward out\-of\-the\-box behavior where doing so improves maintainability and upgradeability.
* Create implementation guides, configuration documentation, demonstrations, knowledge articles, and transition materials; support user training and knowledge transfer as needed.


Qualifications:
**Required Qualifications and Certifications**
----------------------------------------------

* Three or more years of hands\-on ServiceNow implementation/configuration experience in enterprise environments.
* Demonstrated expertise in at least two ServiceNow capability areas such as ITSM, ITOM/Discovery, CMDB/CSDM, IntegrationHub, SPM, Performance Analytics, App Engine, or SecOps.
* Hands\-on ability with Business Rules, Client Scripts, UI Policies, ACLs, Script Includes, Flow Designer, catalog/workflow configuration, REST/SOAP APIs, and ServiceNow data/configuration concepts.
* Experience with controlled release promotion, update sets/application repositories, CI/CD, automated testing, and release documentation.
* ServiceNow CSA plus one or more relevant CIS credentials strongly preferred or required where mandated by the applicable labor category.
* Strong communication and requirements\-translation skills, with demonstrated ability to work with architects, developers, analysts, operations staff, and customer stakeholders.
* Ability to support the assigned late implementation window and planned after\-hours/on\-call events.
* S. citizenship and ability to satisfy High Risk IT background\-investigation and sensitive\-information requirements.

**Preferred Qualifications and Certifications**
-----------------------------------------------

* Federal consulting or financial\-regulatory experience.
* App Engine Studio, UI Builder/Workspace, IntegrationHub, CMDB Health, or ATF experience.
* Experience implementing ServiceNow capabilities in a shared multi\-vendor platform with formal architecture/security governance.


About Us:

At NetImpact Strategies, we post salary ranges in compliance with the specific labor laws and regulations of each county and state, ensuring transparency and fairness in our hiring practices. This approach reflects our commitment to adhering to legal requirements and promoting equitable pay standards across all regions where we operate. The posted salary range for this role is $90,000\-110,000\. The posted salary range is not an exact indication of the actual compensation offered and is instead a range of what NetImpact, in good faith, could compensate at the lowest and most high end of the salary market. In general, NetImpact may not pay the top of the salary range. Compensations are determined by several mitigating factors including skillset, experience, trainings, location, and other factors including benefits packages.Perks of working at NetImpact Strategies

* Your health comes first – we offer comprehensive medical, dental, \& vision insurance that starts the first of the month after you join the team
* Invest in your future – 401(k) Plan – Immediately vested employer contributions; no matching required
* Work hard, play hard – we offer a generous Paid Time Off (PTO) policy, one (1\) additional day of paid wellness leave per calendar year, and observe ten (10\) federal holidays
* Pawsitively pawesome – Pet Insurance (because our little critters are part of our families, too!)
* Invest in your education – Tuition reimbursement, internal training programs, \& company\-sponsored industry certifications!
* Be part of a dynamic and collaborative work environment recently ranked by The Washington Post as a Top Work Place in 2019, 2021,2022, 2023, \& 2024!
* Have fun and celebrate and give back – Team building activities, community volunteering, quarterly HQ days, wellness events, happy hours, family fun events, and more!

 **ABOUT US**


NetImpact Strategies Inc. (NetImpact) has been a Trusted Advisor driving impact through digital transformation for the Federal Government for over a decade. We solve complex problems with innovation and agility to create meaningful, transformative, and enduring change. As Trusted Advisors, NetImpact professionals partner with customer agencies to deliver solutions that empower them to not only meet their missions but also realize their strategic vision through agile, outcome\-focused solutions addressing both strategic and tactical requirements. We design and implement comprehensive, tailored solutions that are both mindful of the client's culture and organizational dynamics. NetImpact’s core values and commitment to a customer and results\-oriented delivery approach has propelled our growth and enabled us to deliver impactful value across Strategic Consulting, Process Automation, Cloud, DevSecOps, Data and Analytics, and Cyber Security for the Federal Government.

**ACCESSIBILITY NOTE**


NetImpact Strategies is committed to complying with all applicable provisions of the Americans with Disabilities Act, as amended (“ADA”), and applicable state and local laws. It is NetImpact’s policy not to discriminate against any qualified person or applicant with regard to any terms or conditions of employment on the basis of such individual’s disability. Consistent with this policy of non\-discrimination, NetImpact will provide reasonable accommodations to an individual with a disability, as defined in the ADA or applicable law, who has made NetImpact aware of his/her disability, unless doing so would cause undue hardship to NetImpact. If you are an applicant and need reasonable accommodation when applying for job opportunities within NetImpact, or request reasonable accommodation to utilize NetImpact’s online employment application, please contact careers@netimpactstrategies.com.
